subject: TARGET CLAIM: Fold7 physical-panel ID cache lifetime and revalidation
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-physical-panel-id-revalidation-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. CLAIMED_BOUNDARY=DuoShellService cachedCoverPhysicalDisplayId/cachedInnerPhysicalDisplayId lifetime after initial resolution, and whether cached IDs remain valid/same-panel identities across a surviving shell process when Android display/compositor state is disrupted or re-enumerated. Current source permanently returns cached IDs and later passes them to SurfaceControl.getPhysicalDisplayToken()/setDisplayPowerMode; no cache invalidation/revalidation path exists before shell process death. This investigation will establish Android/AOSP semantics, identify the narrow failure modes that are actually possible, build an Android-free resolver/revalidation model, adversarially test stale/missing/rebound identities, and hand off a minimal contract to primary if warranted. Explicit exclusions: logical display-ID remap policy, cover-route readiness/retry, cover lease CAS, app-process foreign-lease recovery, semantic re-close/hinge ingress, presentation/native handoff, input/security/visual-phase work, and production GitHub writes. DEVICE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED for any Samsung-specific lifetime conclusion; no defect incidence is claimed yet.
